title: Systemutvecklare
description:
**Arbetsbeskrivning**

Du kommer att ingå i vår produktorganisation där du deltar i utveckling av vår programvara. Du kommer även att samarbeta med vår projekt- och leveransorganisation i olika kundprojekt.


**Din profil och bakgrund**


Du är civilingenjör, högskoleingenjör eller motsvarande och vi ser gärna att du är i början på din karriär.


Du har intresse och erfarenhet inom några av dessa områden:


* Utveckling i C#
* Utveckling av Windowsklienter i utvecklingsplattformen .NET
* Utveckling av appar med MAUI
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft Visual Studio och Team Foundation Server är meriterande
* Databasdesign och -programmering mot relationsdatabaser

Hos oss får du möjligheten att utvecklas och bli en expert inom C#, .NET och Maui. Vi genomför flera interna Coding Dojos och interna utvecklingsdagar där vi tävlar i kreativitet. Allt för att skapa en miljö där vi alla fortsätter att utvecklas till experter inom våra områden.


Vi ser gärna att du är innovativ, gillar problemlösning och trivs bra med att arbeta i grupp. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Eftersom vi är en global produktleverantör är det viktigt att du behärskar svenska och engelska, såväl i tal som i skrift.


### **Om Ides**


Ides är ett svenskt mjukvaruföretag i tillväxt. Vi utvecklar och levererar lösningar för teknisk information och anläggningsdata – från idé till underhåll. Hos oss har du stora möjligheter att utvecklas och att påverka såväl dina egna arbetsuppgifter som resultat för företaget. Vi bedriver IT-utveckling på aktuella plattformar såsom C#, .NET, AutoCAD, Oracle, SQL Server, Maui m.m.


Vi är ett modernt företag bestående av trevliga arbetskamrater i trivsamma lokaler.
  

Vårt huvudkontor är centralt beläget i Linköping, bara ett par hundra meter från tågstationen.
  

Vi har också kontor i Västerås, Karlstad, Göteborg och Shanghai, Kina.


### **Ansökan**


Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till: **jobs@idesglobal.com**

title: System Developer – Portfolio Investments Applications
description:
Civilingenjör, systemutveckling Västra Götalands län
Heltid Publicerad: 16 oktober 2026 Sök senast: **14 april 2027**
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!


**About The Role**


As a System Developer at Myntro, you’ll join our DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you’ll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.


Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You’ll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You’ll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.


**In this role, you will:**


* Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.
* Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.
* Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
* Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.
* Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.
* Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

**Who You Are**


We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You’re comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.


You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You’re pragmatic and collaborative, but you don’t wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.


AI-assisted development isn’t new to you; it’s already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you’re paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We’re actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.


**We see that you likely have:**


* A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5 years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.
* Strong .NET/C# development skills.
* Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.
* Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.
* Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you’re interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.


**Why join Myntro?**


At Myntro, you’ll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.


This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You’ll be part of a team that’s expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.


Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.


**Interested? Welcome to apply!**


Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don’t wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.


For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Lema Naderi, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – lema.naderi@myntro.com


**We look forward to receiving your application!**

title: Software Engineer
description:

*Bonus: Experience with high-performing/low-latency systems or a personal interest in investments.*

title: iOS Engineer – Podme
description:

 As a part of our vision to enrich people’s lives through stories, we’re looking for a skilled iOS Engineer to join our team in Stockholm. In this role, you’ll work closely with teammates in product, design, backend, and QA to continuously improve our iOS app. Your contributions will help ensure a seamless, delightful experience for our growing user base across podcasts and audiobooks.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to grow your skills in a supportive team and contribute to a fast-growing company where audio and technology meet.

* Contribute to the implementation of scalable and modern architecture as defined by the team.
* Develop, test, and release high-quality iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
* Collaborate closely with product, design, backend, QA, and DevOps to support the delivery of impactful features.
* Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate test coverage.
* Support automated testing and app stability in collaboration with QA.
* Help manage CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps.
* Participate in code reviews and share best practices.

 You care about performance, user experience, and building maintainable, scalable solutions. You enjoy writing clean code, collaborating, bring an investigative mindset, and solving complex technical problems.
   

  

* Strong understanding of Apple’s design and development guidelines.
* Strong investigative mindset with a structured approach to problem-solving and debugging.
* Good understanding of SwiftUI and Reactive programming (Combine/RxSwift/ReactiveSwift).
* Some understanding of CoreData/SwiftData and Streaming (AVFoundation)

 At Podme, we believe in the power of audio stories to inform, entertain, and inspire. Backed by Schibsted—one of the Nordics’ leading media groups—we’re on a mission to deliver the best of podcasting and audiobooks to listeners across Sweden, Norway, and Finland.
   

  

* Join a fast-growing company with a loyal and expanding user base
* Modern tech stack and space to influence architecture decisions
* Strong engineering culture built on trust, autonomy, and ownership
* Hybrid setup (3 days/week in our Stockholm office)
* Great benefits through Schibsted: private healthcare, wellness allowance, flexible work
* Free access to premium Podme content and audiobooks


 Help us build the backbone of the Nordic audio revolution: code that delivers value, joy, and reliability.
   

  

 Your next great challenge starts here.
   

  

 Apply now and let’s build something great together.
   

  

**About Podme**
 Podme is the place for premium podcasts and audiobooks. With over 350,000 paying subscribers, we’re available in Sweden, Norway, and Finland, and part of Schibsted Media since 2021.
   

  

 Our vision is to enrich people’s lives through stories, which embodies our core belief in the power of narratives to bring joy, meaning, and connection to individuals. We strive to create effortless and habit-forming audio and product experiences that resonate with the listener and add value in their everyday lives.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Meet Yubico**
 Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. Publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm with headquarters in Sweden, the US, and Singapore, we protect everyone from everyday consumers to global enterprises with modern, phishing-resistant authentication.
   

  

**Why Join Our Mission?**
 At Yubico, We Are Guided By a Shared Belief That Your Work Matters. We Operate Under a Cultural Philosophy Of Speed With Integrity, Pushing The Boundaries Of Technology To Secure The AI Frontier—protecting Both Human And Agentic AI Interactions—and Leading The Transition To Post-quantum Cryptography. In Everything We Do, We Live By Our Core Values
   

  

* Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
* Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
* One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.


 Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our
 *Secure it Forward* 
 program.
   

  

**At Yubico, We Offer**
**Yubico Values:** 
 We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico which all employees are welcome to join. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).
   

  

**Social Connection:** 
 Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here
 **.**
**The Role**
 Yubico is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Platform team working on Yubikey as a Service. It is an Enterprise solution that customers use to manage the lifecycle of their credentials and YubiKey deployment at scale. You should have a passion for building the platform for Enterprise-grade applications. We are looking for a teammate who is proactive, works well within and across teams, and has a desire to do things right and learn. You will develop the platform to support products used by many top Enterprise companies and will get to see your work in use right away.
   

  

**Tasks And Responsibilities**
* Understand, enhance, maintain, and grow the platform that powers our services
* Develop your skills in designing and developing a testable, scalable and globally-distributed set of services used by a variety of Enterprise customers
* Work collaboratively across functions - Product Managers, Security, Infrastructure, UX designers, Support
* Work with a variety of technologies and increase your experience in many areas, ranging from cloud platform services and REST design to data compliance and web security
* Work collaboratively with a tight-knit, multi-national development team to create well-architected software
* Participate in an on-call rotation and gain experience supporting business-critical Enterprise services


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3+ years of software development experience (or equivalent)
* Experience building commercial software
* Experience with back-end software development
* Experience working with relational databases
* Experience with one or more common web-backend languages such as (but not limited to) Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, JavaScript (Node.js), C#, Rust


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Hands-on experience with Go and/or Java/Kotlin
* Hands-on experience in one or more of the following technologies: Kubernetes, Docker, Redis
* Experience with one of the three major cloud platforms
* Authentication and authorization technologies, modern security practices


 We are an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity and uphold an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We'd love to learn about what you can add to our diverse team. We are an E-Verify Participating Employer.
   

  

 Yubico does not accept agency resumes or referrals so please do not send them to our careers staff or employees. Yubico is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes or referrals.
   

  

 Personal data submitted through this form is used for managing Yubico’s recruitment activities, which include facilitating any application you make, setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing results and selecting candidates, and as otherwise needed in our recruitment and onboarding processes. The use of your personal data may also be necessary prior to entering into a contract with you (that is prior to offering you a job with Yubico). We only keep your personal data for as long as necessary and in compliance with Yubico’s record retention policies. In this notice, when we refer to "Yubico", "us", "we" or "our", we mean the Yubico group company or companies that you apply to, or correspond with, and which are responsible for any personal data collected about you.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:

 **Senior backend engineer to join our Stockholm office** 
 with strong,
 **hands‑on expertise in modern Java,**

title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Senior iOS Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel iOS app. The iOS team is two engineers, and you'd be the third. We're moving off legacy Objective-C toward a modern Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine stack, and shifting the architecture from VIPER to MVVM-C, all while continuously shipping product features to a global user base. You'll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our iOS platform.
 



  





**Areas Of Ownership** 



* Drive the modernization from legacy Objective-C to a modern Swift + SwiftUI stack
* Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt
* Build and modernize iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine
* Contribute to architecture decisions (VIPER to MVVM-C transition, Combine, platform improvements)
* Collaborate closely with Android, Web, Product, Design to ship the right solutions
* Ship to the App Store and monitor what happens after release
* Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed
* Maintain and improve the overall health of the iOS platform



**Requirements** 



* 5+ years building iOS apps
* Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine
* Comfortable maintaining and modernizing legacy Objective-C
* Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM-C, VIPER)
* Shipped production iOS apps to the App Store, including post-release monitoring
* Experience with REST and/or GraphQL, with solid error handling and async patterns
* Can work independently and ship without constant oversight
* Write unit tests, cover edge cases, and give code reviews that favor simple solutions
* Work effectively with AI coding tools



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we're profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. We make it cheap and easy for migrants to call and send money home. Millions of people move countries every year, and staying connected with family shouldn't cost a fortune. That's the problem we work on, from a small, international team based in Stockholm where speed and ownership matter more than process.
 



**Benefits** 



* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots, and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support



*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Android Utvecklare till B3 Mobile

 Vi är ett team av passionerade utvecklare som älskar att lösa komplexa problem och bygga högkvalitativa, användarvänliga applikationer. Vi arbetar i en dynamisk och kreativ miljö där samarbete och ständigt lärande är nyckeln till framgång.

 Som Androidutvecklare hos oss kommer du att ha en central roll i hela utvecklingsprocessen – från idé och design till implementation och lansering. Du kommer att arbeta med moderna arkitekturer och tekniker för att bygga robusta och skalbara applikationer. Du kommer att få stor frihet att påverka de tekniska besluten och arbeta med spännande projekt för en rad olika kunder.

* Testing: Du har en god förståelse för enhetstestning och integrationstester med ramverk som JUnit och Espresso.
* Nätverkskommunikation: Kunskap om att integrera med RESTful-API:er och använda bibliotek som Retrofit eller Ktor Client.
* Prestandaoptimering: Förmåga att identifiera och åtgärda prestandaproblem, samt optimera batterianvändning
* Har en bakgrund som civilingenjör eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat


**Vad vi erbjuder**
* Möjlighet att jobba med tekniskt utmanande lösningar för högprofilerade kunder.
* Friheten att alltid ha de bästa verktygen: snabb dator, gott om testtelefoner, rätt tangentbord, alla kablar och licenser du behöver – på eget initiativ.
* Flexibelt upplägg med hybridmodell (en dag i veckan på kontoret för gemenskap och kunskapsutbyte).
* En arbetsplats där du kan växa och utforska de senaste teknikerna tillsammans med ett starkt team.
* Satsningar på ditt välmående – från friskvårdsbidrag till en arbetsmiljö där balans mellan jobb och fritid är en självklarhet.


 Vi tror på energi, nyfikenhet och att dela erfarenheter. Hos oss är olikheter en styrka, och vi vill att du ska känna att du kan växa – både som utvecklare och som människa

title: Senior C# Software Engineer (Web)
description:
Η Megasoft αναζητά έναν ταλαντούχο

**About the role | Build scalable Marketing Automation solutions across the Nordics**

 You’ll join a Nordic team responsible for developing and evolving customer communication capabilities across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.  Your primary focus will be hands-on development in Adobe tech stack. You will design, build, and evolve solutions that support customer communication at scale, while contributing to the architecture, stability, and long-term development of our Marketing Automation platform.
   

  

 This is not a campaign operations role. It is a technical specialist role where you'll work with platform development, integrations, data models, and solution design in a complex enterprise environment.

* Designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale solutions in Adobe, preferably in Campaign Classic or Adobe Experience Manager
* Building technical workflows, integrations, APIs, and custom functionality that support customer communication across the Nordics
* Extending and maintaining data models, schemas, and customer data flows across our MarTech ecosystem
* Driving improvements related to platform capabilities, architecture, performance, scalability, and governance
* Acting as a trusted technical advisor, helping translate business requirements into robust and sustainable technical solutions


**About you | Adobe Developer**
 You are an experienced Adobe developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and taking ownership of solutions from design through implementation.
   

  

 You thrive in environments where development, integrations, architecture, and business needs come together. You understand how technical decisions impact scalability, maintainability, and long-term business value, and you're comfortable challenging requirements and proposing better solutions when needed.

description:
**TL;DR** 
 You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.
* Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM.
* Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse).
* Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem.
* Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration.
* Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs.


**What You'll Do**
* Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks.
* Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team.
* Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through.
* Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection.
* Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it.


**Our tech stack**
* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

**Thomson Reuters** 
 is looking for an
 **Implementation Consultant.** 
 To thrive in this role, you should have strong problem-solving and analytical skills, along with a genuine desire to challenge yourself in your work. You are organized, focused, and able to structure your tasks and priorities independently. You learn new tasks quickly and have both the ability and the willingness to support others, including colleagues and customers.
   

  

**Implementation Consultant** 
 is a dynamic role that involves a broad range of responsibilities. The primary responsibility is to act as an application and solution specialist for the
 **ONESOURCE Pagero** 
 platform. In this position, you will work both independently and collaboratively, as you will often manage several projects in parallel.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

* Demonstrate an understanding of the AP/AR lifecycle and e-invoicing compliance regulations across the EU and APAC regions.

title: SAP Technical Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
   

  

 Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 The SAP Technical Architect is a strategic role that will enable business capabilities with SAP technology. The role includes creation of technology roadmaps as well as governance and support of existing deliveries and will be instrumental in modernising Electrolux technical landscape.
   

  

 Working with the landscape in Electrolux means working with a wide range of applications in a global environment. Electrolux landscape includes applications from on premise ERP, SCM, EWM, etc to public cloud solutions like IBP, CCv2, C4C, etc. There is currently a big modernisation of the landscape moving into private cloud/RISE, Integration Suite, BW/4HANA, BTP and eventually S/4HANA.
   

  

 The successful candidate is passionate about driving business value from technical solutions, analysing and designing solutions and collaborating with different level of stakeholders in a global setting. You will be part of a team of global architects with expertise in different business processes and technologies.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Create and own the SAP landscape strategy and design technical landscapes, both on premise and cloud.
* Establish and maintain SAP technical architecture principles, standards and guardrails to ensure scalable, secure and supportable solutions across the SAP landscape, for example considering data volume and performance.
* Define and govern non-functional requirements including security, availability, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational supportability.
* Own architecture decisions and review proposed solutions from functional and technical teams to ensure alignment with architecture standards.
* Collaborate with SAP, implementation partners and internal teams to jointly resolve complex issues or design solutions.
* Provide architecture leadership and guidance in high-priority support issues.
* Create and own the roadmap for Application Lifecycle Management to ensure the applications used are efficiently supporting the IT processes.
* Participate in ERP modernisation program, including move to private cloud, conversion to S/4HANA and implementation of Business Data Cloud (BDC).
* Proactively monitor innovation and emerging technologies, including AI-driven capabilities, to identify business value opportunities.
* Mentor and provide guidance to technical and functional teams and promote architecture best practices across the organization.


**Who you are:**
* You possess excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to communicate complex concepts to senior IT management, technical, functional and business teams in English.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen, with a solid understanding of SAP business processes and the ability to influence stakeholders through effective relationship management and communication.
* Able to work independently and as part of distributed, multi-disciplinary, multi-national teams with good collaboration skills
* Able to deal with ambiguity and manage multiple priorities
* A proactive learner with a strong passion for continuously expanding your knowledge and skills across SAP technologies and the broader digital ecosystem.
* Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


**Required qualifications** 
**:**
* 8+ years of SAP technical platform and architecture experience, including significant experience designing and governing enterprise-scale hybrid SAP landscapes.
* Proven experience acting as SAP Technical Architect, Lead SAP Basis Architect, SAP Platform Architect or equivalent architecture leadership role.
* Application Lifecycle Management, including e.g. transports, monitoring, testing and documentation using Solution Manager, CloudALM and/or third party tools.
* S/4HANA conversion, preferably with experience in optimizing downtime.
* Experience with SAP BTP platform architecture, account models, service enablement, for example linked to AI.


**Nice to have** 
 :
   

  

 The following experience is a plus, but not mandatory:
   

  

* SAP Security, including roles and authorisation design.
* Integration technology (PI/PO, CPI, Integration Suite).
* Custom development on stack and side-by-side in BTP or non-SAP platforms.
* SAP licensing and commercial models (on-premise, RISE, BTP and cloud subscriptions).
* FinOps, linking cloud consumption with financial processes, both for public cloud and credit-based solutions such as BTP, BDC, AI and PCE/RISE.
* Experience working with Enterprise Architecture frameworks.


**Where you will be:**
 This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
   

  

 We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
   

  

 With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
   

  

**Benefits highlights:**
* Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
* Comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
* Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
* Access to in-house sports facilities.


 We look forward to receiving your application!
   

  

 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Metadataspecialist
description:
Är du intresserad av att arbeta med metadata och verksamhetsutveckling inom bibliotekssektorn? Vill du bidra till utveckling och samordning av metadata för prioriterade grupper?
   

  

 Som metadataspecialist på Enheten för metadata och nationalbibliografin får du möjlighet att arbeta med den metadata som Kungliga biblioteket (KB) ansvarar för som Sveriges nationalbibliotek. Metadatan används bland annat inom Librissamarbetet och för nationalbibliografin.
   

  

 Hos oss får du bidra till att forma förutsättningarna för hur Sveriges kulturarv beskrivs, organiseras och görs sökbart för alla, både idag och för framtida generationer. Rollen erbjuder ett varierat arbete där strategiska frågor kombineras med praktiskt metadataarbete och utveckling av nationell infrastruktur.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Arbete på Enheten för metadata och nationalbibliografin innefattar bland annat att:
   

  

* skapa, uppdatera och kvalitetssäkra entiteter som används vid resursbeskrivning och inom länkade data
* arbeta med kontrollerade vokabulärer, såsom ämnesord, termlistor och namnformer
* bidra till utveckling och förvaltning av metadata utifrån nationella och internationella standarder
* arbeta tillsammans med kollegor för att säkerställa tillförlitliga och funktionella metadata
* ge stöd i informations- och utbildningsinsatser kopplade till enhetens ansvarsområden
* delta i och driva utvecklings- och utredningsarbete inom metadataområdet.


 Vi behöver nu förstärka enheten med kompetens inom metadata för att kunna tillgodose frågor kopplade till bibliotekslagens prioriterade grupper, däribland nationella minoriteter. Med detta avser vi utveckling och förvaltning av metadata som gör samlingar och kulturarvsmaterial sökbara, begripliga och tillgängliga för alla. I rollen kommer du att kartlägga och analysera befintliga metadataresurser, bedöma deras användbarhet och tillförlitlighet samt bidra till att utveckla strategier, arbetssätt och rekommendationer för hur KB ska arbeta med metadata inom området.
   

  

 Du kommer också att samverka med externa organisationer och nätverk för att stärka utvecklingen av gemensamma metadataresurser och god praxis.
   

  

 Funktionen är central i KB:s avdelningsövergripande metadataarbete.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer och personliga egenskaper**
 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du:
   

  

* akademisk examen inom informations- och biblioteksvetenskap eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
* erfarenhet av arbete med metadata, både praktiskt och teoretiskt
* god förståelse för hur metadata, entiteter och kontrollerade vokabulärer används för beskrivning, sökning och återanvändning av information
* erfarenhet av att analysera, utreda och utveckla arbetssätt eller verksamhetsprocesser
* god kommunikativ förmåga och kunna uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande är:**
* erfarenhet av praktiskt arbete med länkade data, t.ex. kontrollerade vokabulärer som ämnesord eller andra termlistor
* erfarenhet av samverkan med externa aktörer och nätverk
* erfarenhet av arbete på bibliotek, arkiv, museum eller annan kunskapsintensiv verksamhet


 Vi söker dig som är lyhörd, analytisk och har ett genuint intresse för metadatafrågor. Du trivs med att kombinera strategiska perspektiv med praktiskt genomförande och har förmåga att driva arbetet framåt även när vägen inte är utstakad.
   

  

 Du arbetar självständigt, tar initiativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra. Eftersom rollen innebär många kontaktytor värdesätter vi att du är kommunikativ och har förmåga att skapa goda relationer såväl internt som externt.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken på utveckling och förändring, ser möjligheter i nya arbetssätt och vill bidra till att stärka KB:s roll som nationell aktör inom metadataområdet.
   

  

 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Anställning och tillträde**
 Det här är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde sker snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Placering är i centrala Stockholm. KB har verksamhet på flera orter, bland annat i Stockholm, Strängnäs och Bålsta, vilket innebär att tjänsteresor kan förekomma. Säkerhetsintervju samt bakgrundskontroll och arbetsprov kan komma att genomföras med slutkandidat.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-01 och bifoga CV. I stället för personligt brev använder vi oss av urvalsfrågor där du beskriver varför du är intresserad av denna tjänst och vad du kan bidra med. Var därför noga med dina svar så att de speglar din kompetens och erfarenhet på ett korrekt sätt.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**

Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
   

  

 This role is

 Team

Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

 Voodoo is creating a small experimentation team with a big mission: find the next best way to entertain the world by taking one of our best hits,

 to a new level.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 As a Game Lead, you will be the owner of your game and team. Your mission will be to define the right direction, build the team, and drive execution with speed, focus and ambition.

* Build and lead your own small team, starting with around 4 people
* Set clear goals and make sure the team reaches them
* Lead, inspire and motivate the people working on the game
* Focus first on improving core gameplay, game feel, pacing and player satisfaction

 Profile
   

  

* 4 to 5+ years of experience in the gaming industry (Development, Product, Design, Art etc.)

* A passion for mobile games and a strong understanding of core gameplay, game feel, player experience and iteration
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset

**Benefits**

title: Senior AI Tech Architect - Stockholm | BCG Platinion
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Are you ready to transform the challenges of digitalization and AI into tomorrow’s solutions? Join BCG Platinion in tackling the core technology issues of leading global companies as a Senior AI Tech Architect in Stockholm!
   

  

 Shape and lead strategies, organizations, platforms, and digital solutions that help our clients capture the potential of technology and AI. Work at the intersection of business and technology across topics such as generative and agentic AI, cloud, data, DevOps, and digital platforms.  What You'll Do
   

  

 For our Stockholm office, we are looking for Senior AI Tech Architects to help our clients on national and international projects! (Senior) AI Tech Architects are part of our consulting teams who focus for instance on tech-oriented analyses, review & specification of IT systems or architectures, technical solution design, process improvement and target architecture definitions.
   

  

 Together with colleagues from BCG Platinion and/or the Boston Consulting Group, you will develop superior IT strategies, concepts, and solutions actively and on site, applying your technical know-how combined with your analytical and conceptual skillset.  What You'll Bring

Depending on the project, you may design an enterprise AI platform, lead the architecture of an agentic solution, guide the development of a GenAI application, modernize a legacy technology landscape, define a cloud and data architecture, or provide the technical backbone for a large-scale digital transformation.

title: Post-doc position at the Center for Migration and Integration at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE)
description:
**About The Center For Migration And Integration Research**
 The Center for Migration and Integration Research (CMIR), housed at the SSE House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), aims to create a platform to support the sustainable integration of third-country nationals in Sweden. Together with key stakeholders in the migration and integration process, experiences and insights are researched and incorporated into a systemic perspective. The Center emphasizes the importance of the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in the governance of migration and integration, at multiple levels, and focuses not only on employment, but also on other dimensions of sustainable migration and integration. The research team collects, creates, and disseminates multiple-actor, science-based knowledge on the governance of migration and integration in Sweden for societal and social sustainability.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a postdoctoral researcher, you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers contribute to:
   

  

* Conducting and publishing original research aligned with the Center’s thematic focus and scholarly ambition.
* Collaborating with fellow researchers on interdisciplinary projects
* Participating in the scholarly community through conferences and workshops
* Participating in the Center’s multistakeholder activities, e.g., workshops, roundtables, and dialogue forums
* Translating research findings into formats that are accessible to external audiences.


 Your profile
   

  

 The successful candidate will have built a research agenda during their PhD, as evidenced by publications, and are keen to extend methodological and theoretical expertise in the broad field of migration and integration. Their general disciplinary background should be within the social sciences, preferably with a legal, economics or business focus connected to the fields of migration and integration. The center is led by the Center Director, Associate Professor Lin Lerpold, together with the Scientific Director, Professor Laurence Romani.
   

  

 As a candidate, you thrive in a research environment directed towards impact, that is, a multidisciplinary and multi-paradigmatic environment where research aims at making contributions to both academic knowledge and a more sustainable society. You are open, considerate, and sympathetic to different research disciplines and paradigms such as positivist, interpretivist, and critical. You have strong qualities in both research and outreach communication activities.
   

  

 While successful candidates are expected to master either qualitative or quantitative  methods, knowledge of and the ability to use both are a merit. Though research aims to be published in high-ranking international journals, an interest in the Swedish context within the larger EU frame, as well as sufficient reading and oral communication in Swedish is necessary. Beyond basic academic research, the successful candidates will be expected to contribute to, and participate in, the Center’s multistakeholder activities as well as communicate their research in policy and practitioner briefs.
   

  

 The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and show an ability and ambition to publish manuscripts in highly ranked, international scholarly journals. To be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement, while full proficiency in Swedish is an advantage. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest October 30th, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:
   

  

* A curriculum vitae
* A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).
* Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)
* Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts
* Names and contact information for three people willing to provide references.


 We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before October 30th, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around January 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of up to 18 months.
   

  

 For further questions on the positions, please contact Lin Lerpold: lin.lerpold@hhs.se or Laurence Romani: laurence.romani@hhs.se. For HR-related questions, contact Ellen Falkenström: ellen.falkenstrom@hhs.se.
   

  

**About The House Of Governance And Public Policy (GaPP)**
 The SSE House of Governance and Public Policy is a multidisciplinary institution with 8 research centers housing leading researchers and educators. We conduct cutting edge research and education of societal relevance, to assist in professional development and capacity building in organizational and societal governance, and in the development of scientifically based public policy.

title: UX Designer Mobile App

 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely.  Design at Worldline is going through an exciting transformation. We're raising the bar — fast. The momentum is real, the ambition is high, and the impact is visible.

Your mission is to advocate for the user's needs, defining and implementing intuitive solutions for the product direction, visuals, and experience to enhance their overall mobile user journey. You will bring deep expertise in native mobile design, leveraging your understanding of platform conventions, touch-first interactions, and on-the-go usage contexts to craft experiences that feel natural and effortless. While your primary focus will be on mobile, you will also contribute to the broader product experience, ensuring seamless continuity across platforms.

* Champion mobile-specific design patterns, including touch interactions, gestures, responsive layouts, and platform-specific conventions (Human Interface Guidelines & Material Design).

**Perks & Benefits**

**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

title: Juniora Analysts till Deloitte Digital (Stockholm) - Aug 2027
description:
Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.
   

  

  




**Jobbeskrivning**

 Inom Deloitte Digital stödjer du Deloittes kunder med strategi, rådgivning och systemimplementation för att utveckla deras e-handels-, försäljning-, kundservice- och marknadsföringsfunktioner. En stor del av ditt arbete inkluderar implementation av system så som Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Adobe som Commercetools. Förutom systemutveckling bygger Deloitte Digital skräddarsydda lösningar i tech stacks som React, Next.js, Swift, Kotlin. I vårt team finner du utvecklare (frontend / backend), applikationsspecialister, kravanalytiker och verksamhetsutvecklare. Hos oss kommer du kunna stärka din tekniska kompetens och jobba med bland annat utveckling, teknisk arkitektur, data och systemintegration. Du kommer att arbeta nära klient för att stärka deras kundupplevelse genom strategiska och taktiska initiativ samtidigt som du utvecklar djup branschkunskap och verksamhetsförståelse.
   

  

  




**Kvalifikationer**

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

  




* Är nyexaminerad med en masterexamen inom systemvetenskap eller ingenjörsvetenskap, med inriktning mot data.
* Har relevant arbetserfarenhet eller stort intresse för data, kodning och systemutveckling samt businessförståelse och bransch-kompetens.


 Meriterande:
   

  

  

* Goda studieresultat, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna
* Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv
* Intresse för hur digitalisering / AI och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher


*Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå.*
**Ytterligare information**

**Vi erbjuder**
  

 Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.
   

  

  





 Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.
   

  

  





**Ansökan**
  

 Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:
   

  

  




* CV


* Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.


 I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.
   

  

  


 Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. https://tofindout.se/sv/faq/. För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.
   

  

  





**Frågor**
  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare William Lim, wilim@deloitte.se
   

  

  





 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

  





**What impact will you make?**




 På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: Principal Game Designer | New Games
description:
**Craft:**
**Job Description:**
**Principal Game Designer (Puzzle Core)**
**Help craft the moment to moment magic of a new King Game**
 Join our New Games Studio and help build the next generation of King experiences. We’re developing a new casual puzzle game and we’re looking for a Principal Game Designer to help shape the feel, challenge, and moment to moment fun of the game.
   

  

 In this role, you will design and evolve the core puzzle gameplay, including level mechanics, blockers, moment to moment interaction systems, and overall difficulty progression that define the player experience.
   

  

 Working closely project Leadership, you will help craft gameplay that is deeply satisfying, approachable, and scalable across thousands of levels, ensuring that the game delivers both delightful player experiences and strong long term engagement.
   

  

**Your Role Within Our Kingdom**
 As a Principal Game Designer, you will play a key role in defining and refining the core gameplay systems of the game, helping ensure the puzzle experience remains engaging, readable, and satisfying for players across the entire progression journey.
   

  

 You will work closely with other designers, artists, engineers, and product partners to bring gameplay features to life and ensure they align with both the creative vision and the broader game strategy.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Design and iterate on the core puzzle gameplay, ensuring the moment-to-moment interaction feels satisfying, responsive, and accessible.
* Create and evolve blockers and level mechanics, developing gameplay elements that introduce challenge, variety, and strategic depth.
* Help define the overall gameplay feel, including pacing, readability, clarity, and player feedback.
* Collaborate with design leadership team to ensure blockers and mechanics integrate well into the wider level progression.
* Partner with Product Managers and Data Scientists to analyse player behaviour and tune gameplay difficulty, progression, and engagement.
* Prototype and develop new gameplay mechanics, exploring ideas that enhance the puzzle experience and expand the game’s design space.
* Ensure gameplay systems align with the game’s broader meta and economy systems, working with systems and economy designers when necessary.
* Maintain high standards of design quality, balancing creative ambition with technical constraints and production realities.
* Document and clearly communicate gameplay designs, ensuring teams across disciplines understand design goals and player outcomes.
* Identify and communicate design risks early, working closely with producers and engineers to ensure smooth delivery.
* Stay connected to the market, analysing puzzle and casual games to identify emerging trends and opportunities.
* Contribute to the studio’s design craft community, sharing learnings and supporting the growth of fellow designers.


**Skills To Create Thrills**
* Experience working on mobile games, particularly free to play titles.
* Strong passion for casual mobile games and meta game design.
* Proven experience designing meta systems, progression frameworks, or long term engagement mechanics in successful games.
* Strong understanding of player motivation, progression design, and long term engagement loops.
* Experience designing systems that connect gameplay with progression, rewards, and feature unlocks.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret player behaviour and data insights to guide iteration.
* Experience collaborating within multidisciplinary teams, balancing creative, technical, and product perspectives.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to drive features from concept through delivery.
* Clear and effective communicator verbally, visually, and in written documentation.
* Comfortable working in fast-moving development environments where systems evolve through iteration.
* Experience working on Sorting / Match Pair / Match 3D mechanics is especially valuable.


**Game Experience**
 We’re looking for someone with a strong background in creating video games and a passion for designing compelling casual meta experiences. Mobile development comes with unique opportunities and constraints, requiring a balance of creativity, insight, and technical awareness. We want someone who embraces those challenges with enthusiasm and a desire to craft experiences that will delight millions of players around the world.
   

  

**We’re Seriously Playful**
 Officially, we’re a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world. Unofficially, we’re a serious business that takes pride in having fun. Every day at King, we blend intuition with analysis, art with science, and imagination with execution to craft games the world loves to play.
   

  

 Our mission is simple: bring moments of magic to everyday life. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**A great saga needs all sorts of heroes**
 Making games is fun. Especially when you do it with people who share the same idea of what makes a good workplace great.
   

  

 We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life.
   

  

 Truth is, we simply can’t expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Gruppchef för utveckling och förvaltning till Rättsmedicinalverket
description:
Göteborg



Referensnummer X26-90443



*Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete där din kompetens bidrar till att stärka rättssäkerheten? Rättsmedicinalverket är expertmyndigheten som ger rättsväsendet underlag för viktiga beslut – från rättsmedicin och forensiska analyser till rättspsykiatriska utredningar. Oavsett om du arbetar i kärnverksamheten eller i en stödjande roll är du en del av något större: att bidra till ett rättssäkert samhälle.*


Nu söker vi en gruppchef för utveckling och förvaltning till it- och digitaliseringsenheten i Stockholm.


It- och digitaliseringsenheten ingår i myndighetens huvudkontor och ansvarar för it-drift, -förvaltning och -utveckling i syfte att öka takten i digitaliseringsarbetet. RMV genomför nu flera utvecklingsinsatser och utökar då även organisationen för it- och digitalisering. Då tidigare gruppchef för utveckling och förvaltning går vidare till annan anställning, så genomförs denna ersättningsrekrytering.


**Ditt uppdrag**  

I rollen som gruppchef för utveckling och förvaltning, leder du personal inom grupperingen och ska säkerställa att vi levererar tjänster som säkerställer att våra kärnverksamheter har de systemstöd som de behöver för att kunna bedriva sin verksamhet med kvalitet och effektivitet. Du har personal- och budgetansvar för dessa delar. Du deltar i styrgrupper för förvaltningsobjekt och projekt, följer upp leveranser och avtal, deltar i upphandlingar och koordinerar det dagliga arbetet i gruppen.


Gruppen består idag av tio medarbetare med olika teknisk kompetens samt en handfull konsulter. ansvarar för områden som applikationsförvaltning, projektledning, arkitektur och cybersäkerhet. Arbetsuppgifter för medarbetarna i gruppen omfattar bland annat att arbeta med kravställning, projektledning, systemförvaltning, arkitektur, standarder, processutveckling, leverantörsstyrning och uppföljning, avtalsuppföljning, upphandling och livscykelhantering.


Gruppchefsrollen är utvecklande och varierad, då du arbetar både med att säkerställa det dagliga arbetet i förvaltning och projekt samtidigt som du får utrymme att vidareutveckla både dig själv, gruppen och leveransen. Du förväntas bidra i det strategiska arbetet för it- och digitaliseringsenheten och ingår i enhetens ledningsgrupp.


**Kvalifikationer**


* Utbildning på högskolenivå inom it-området (ingenjör, datavetare, systemvetare) eller motsvarande erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
* Flerårig ledarerfarenhet i form av personalansvar, projektledaransvar eller motsvarande erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
* Mångårig och aktuell erfarenhet och bred teknisk kompetens inom förvaltning eller systemutveckling.

Meriterande


* Kunskap och erfarenhet från andra it-områden, exempelvis drift, krav, test, arkitektur, integration eller liknande kunskap.
* Erfarenhet från organisationer som arbetar enligt ramverken PM3 och ITIL eller liknande.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i offentlig verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med informationssäkerhet, ex lagstiftning, it-säkerhetsmekanismer eller motsvarande.
* Arbetat med förvaltning och utveckling i organisationer med höga säkerhetskrav, såsom myndigheter inom rättskedjan, inom sjukvård, bank, försvarsindustri eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet av att införa och underhålla modeller och metoder inom förvaltning och utveckling samt arkitektur.
* Kunskap om och erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling.

  

**Personliga egenskaper/förmågor**  

Vi letar efter dig som kan kombinera ett närvarande ledarskap med ett analytiskt förhållningssätt och tekniskt kunnande. Vi söker dig som har en personlig mognad, som leder, motiverar och ger dina medarbetare stöd och förutsättningar i sitt arbete och skapar engagemang genom delaktighet och transparens. Du kan kombinera ett strategiskt framåtblickande perspektiv med det dagliga taktiska och operativa arbetet. Du sätter tydliga mål och förväntningar och utvecklar verksamheten genom att arbeta strukturerat med att styra, leda och följa upp leveranser och förbättringar. Det är viktigt att du har förmåga att skapa goda relationer. På Rättsmedicinalverket arbetar många olika experter och det är därför angeläget för oss att du kan föra dialog med personer som har olika bakgrund och kompetens och därmed bidra till förtroende och ett gott samarbete. Vi fäster stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.


Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. RMV tillämpar provanställning. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm. Myndighetens enheter finns på olika orter i Sverige, varför resor i tjänsten kan förekomma. Det finns utifrån verksamhetens behov möjlighet att teckna enskild överenskommelse om distansarbete del av arbetstid. Rättsmedicinalverket tillämpar individuell lönesättning.
  

  

RMV är en del av rättskedjan och vi ställer höga krav på medarbetarnas omdöme och säkerhetstänkande samt respekt för lag och ordning. Som företrädare för Rättsmedicinalverket följer du den statliga värdegrunden och bidrar genom ditt sätt att agera till rättssäkerhet, rättstrygghet och förtroende för myndigheten.


Vi genomför en bakgrundskontroll för vissa av våra anställningar genom att kontrollera utdrag ur belastningsregister. I samband med anställning vid RMV kan följa en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Befattningen kan komma att bli inplacerad i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kan därmed komma att genomföras under anställningen. Det innebär att du då behöver vara svensk medborgare.


Vi tillämpar en kompetensbaserad rekryteringsprocess där det kan förekomma arbetspsykologiska tester, kunskapsprov eller arbetsprov.

  

  

**Vill du också vara med och bidra till ett rättssäkert samhälle?**  

Välkommen med din **ansökan senast den 1/11-2026.** Betyg och övriga handlingar tas med vid en eventuell intervju. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter kontakta nedan angiven chef.
  

  

Rättsmedicinalverket värnar om en rekrytering fri från diskriminering och verkar för att ge lika rättigheter och möjligheter.  



  

**Vill du veta mer?**  

För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta IT-och digitaliseringschef Susanne Kilgren. Fackliga företrädare är för Saco Maritha Torkildsen Nilsson, för ST/OFR Selma El Hadi, och för Seko Christer Johansson. Samtliga nås via vår växel tfn: 010-483 41 00.


Läs gärna om våra förmåner:
  

https://www.rmv.se/om-oss/jobba-hos-oss/att-jobba-pa-rattsmedicinalverket/formaner-hos-oss/
  

  

Vi är den medicinska länken i rättskedjan. Här jobbar läkare, utredare, rättsmedicinska assistenter, biomedicinska analytiker, kemister, administratörer och många fler på uppdrag av bland andra polis, åklagare och domstol.

As Head of Modern Infrastructure within Group IT, you will lead group-wide infrastructure and cloud capabilities, ensuring that Saab’s technology foundation is transformed and modernised while remaining reliable, secure, and resilient in an increasingly digital and globally connected environment.  Your role

 You will drive Saab’s IT transformation agenda forward, ensuring adoption of AI, cloud-native technologies, automation, and modern digital platforms. This requires close alignment between business needs, technology modernization, and operational delivery across Business Areas and Group Functions.

* Lead and transform Saab’s Modern Infrastructure capabilities, enabling reliable, secure, and scalable technology services
* Drive transformation with focus on cloud, AI and modernisation
* Provide cloud-native and automated platforms that empower product teams to build, deploy, and operate services with speed and efficiency
* Ensure stability, availability, and resilience across both modern cloud platforms and legacy infrastructure environments
* Define and drive the roadmap for Modern Infrastructure, including cloud transformation, infrastructure automation, platform standardisation, and modern engineering practices
* Accelerate cloud adoption and migration while ensuring effective governance, security, and operational excellence
* Drive technology cost optimization through FinOps, automation, and efficient platform management
* Establish and enforce standard connectivity patterns and infrastructure standards across the enterprise

* Represent Group IT in cross-functional forums and engage with senior business and technology stakeholders

* Experience from large global organisations; ideally including defence

* Fluency in both Swedish and English, both written and spoken

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 At 0TO9 (Zero to Nine) you’ll build the cloud foundation behind the licensed financial companies we start & scale. Every new venture lands on this platform, in a regulated market where resilience, security and evidence matter as much as speed. It’s a chance to shape that foundation while it’s still young enough to shape.
   

  

 The role covers three areas:
   

  

* The organisation layer. Design and run our AWS landing zone with AWS Control Tower and AWS Organizations: guardrails, service control policies, and preventive and detective controls enforced from the top and applied the same way to every account.
* The venture layer. Create new accounts for new ventures and roll out our infrastructure blueprint in each one, so every venture goes from an empty account to production-grade hosting the same way, every time.
* Resilience and compliance. Define recovery objectives (RTO and RPO) for every critical service, build disaster recovery that meets them, and prove it with recurring tests. Keep the platform compliant with DORA, and be the person who walks auditors and supervisors through our controls and the evidence behind them.


 You’ll work closely with our CTO and CISO on a daily basis.
   

  

 Day to day you will:
   

  

* Build and evolve our infrastructure as code in AWS CDK (TypeScript), reviewed and deployed through pipelines, never by hand.
* Run containerised .NET microservices on ECS Fargate, with RDS (SQL Server and PostgreSQL), S3 and DynamoDB behind them.
* Own identity and access: Okta as our identity provider, federated into IAM Identity Center for SSO, with least-privilege roles and no long-lived keys.
* Run the security baseline across every account: centralised logging, threat detection, configuration compliance, WAF at the edge, KMS encryption everywhere.
* Run recurring disaster recovery and restore tests against our recovery objectives, and turn the results into evidence an auditor can follow.
* Run recurring compliance checks, so we know we’re still compliant between audits rather than finding out during one.
* Keep cost visible: budgets, anomaly detection and tagging, so a surprise on the bill shows up as an alert rather than at month-end.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to turn regulatory requirements, DORA included, into controls that are built, tested and documented.


**How We Build**
 Agentic coding is our default, not an experiment. Across the group, we run a Claude-Code-native workspace:
   

  

* Engineering standards loaded as a skill, so agents apply them automatically.
* A git-backed knowledge base that agents read and extend.
* Agent workflows that take a change from branch to reviewed PR, infrastructure included.
* An automated reviewer in CI that counts as an approving review on a pull request.


 We’re looking for someone who already works this way and makes agents a normal part of how they build, including against live cloud accounts, with the judgement to know when a change needs a human eye first.
   

  

**About You**
 We think you’ll be a great fit if you:
   

  

* Have hands-on experience designing and running production workloads on AWS, ideally across many accounts.
* Have built or operated an AWS landing zone with Control Tower or Organizations, SCPs, account vending and centralised security accounts.
* Write infrastructure as code by default. CDK is preferred; Terraform or CloudFormation is welcome.
* Take ownership, challenge unclear requirements, and put reliability and security ahead of shortcuts.
* Can explain a control to an engineer and to an auditor, and know the difference between configuring a control and evidencing it.
* Already lean on LLMs and agentic tools daily, and see them as leverage, not a shortcut.


**Technical Requirements**
 We build on AWS, with .NET and SQL on the backend. This role lives in the platform, and AWS is a requirement.
   

  

**Cloud & Infrastructure**
* AWS-native: Organizations, Control Tower, ECS/Fargate, RDS, S3, least-privilege IAM.
* Infrastructure as code: CDK in TypeScript, with stacks you can diff, review and roll back.
* Multi-account by design: environments separated by account, not by naming convention.
* EU data residency: you know why region matters, and how to enforce it rather than hope for it.


**Security & Compliance**
* Security by default: WAF, encryption at rest and in transit, customer-managed KMS keys where it matters.
* Zero hardcoded secrets: Secrets Manager with rotation, always.
* Detection that leads somewhere: GuardDuty, Security Hub and Config, with every finding routed to an owner.
* Audit-ready: organisation CloudTrail, log retention by design, and every change traceable to a reviewed PR.


**Resilience & Operations**
* Disaster recovery: RTO and RPO defined per service, DR designs that meet them, and tests on a schedule that prove it.
* Backup and restore: AWS Backup, cross-region copies, and restores rehearsed rather than assumed.
* Observability: CloudWatch and Datadog, with alarms that reach a human.
* Cost control: budgets, anomaly detection and cost allocation tags.


**Delivery & Quality**
* CI/CD fluency: GitHub Actions and CDK Pipelines, or equivalent.
* Reviewable PRs: small diffs, no self-merges, no console changes in production.
* Tested infrastructure: unit-tested constructs and synthesised templates.
* Supply-chain hygiene: dependency and image scanning before ship.


**Nice to have**
* Knowledge of DORA and how it works in practice: ICT risk management, resilience testing, third-party risk and incident reporting.
* Previous fintech or banking industry experience. You’ll ramp faster in a regulated market.
* AWS certifications, for example Solutions Architect Professional or Security Specialty.
* Experience with event-driven platforms (ideally NATS), or with hosting AI workloads on Amazon Bedrock.

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Infrastructure Security
description:

 You'll be the most senior engineer making sure Lovable's infrastructure is impossible to compromise. Cloud, identity, build pipelines, and runtime - yours to harden.

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

* Hands-on with Kubernetes, Terraform, Wiz, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD - and a clear view on supply-chain security (SLSA, sigstore, SBOMs).
* Comfort writing Go, Python, or Rust to ship guardrails as code, not policies as PDFs.

* Partner with Platform, SRE, and the Lovable Apps Platform team to make the secure path the easy path.
* Mentor engineers across the company and raise the security bar by default, not by review.


 Our tech stack
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!

 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
