title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Shape the future with AI at CGI. We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer who wants to turn the possibilities of artificial intelligence and machine learning into solutions that create real value.
   

  

 In this role, you will work at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, data, and generative AI. You will collaborate with colleagues and clients to design, build, deploy, and improve AI powered solutions, from early prototypes and proofs of concept to robust production systems.
   

  

 The role is intentionally broad. Depending on your experience and interests, you may work with traditional machine learning, generative AI and large language models (LLMs), intelligent applications, MLOps, or a combination of these areas.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 As an ML/AI Engineer, you will:
   

  

* Design and develop machine learning and AI solutions for real world business challenges
* Build applications and services using generative AI, LLMs, and modern AI frameworks
* Develop and evaluate solutions such as RAG, AI agents, search, recommendation, prediction, and automation
* Build reliable data and ML pipelines and integrate models into applications and business systems
* Deploy, monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI/ML solutions in production
* Experiment with new models, tools, frameworks, and approaches
* Apply good software engineering, MLOps, security, and responsible AI practices
* Work closely with software engineers, data specialists, architects, domain experts, and client teams
* Translate business needs into practical technical solutions and communicate technical concepts to different audiences.


 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 What we're looking for:
   

  

 We believe you could come from several different backgrounds. You might already be an ML/AI Engineer, or you may have developed strong AI/ML capabilities through software engineering, data science, or data engineering.
   

  

 We are particularly interested in experience with some of the following:
   

  

* Python and modern software development practices
* Machine learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit learn
* Generative AI and LLMs, including prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, evaluation, and/or agentic applications
* Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
* APIs, microservices, containers, and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Data processing, databases, vector databases, and data pipelines
* MLOps / LLMOps, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management


 You don't need to be an expert in everything above. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn and apply new technologies.
   

  

 We believe that:
   

  

 You enjoy solving complex problems and turning ideas into working solutions. You are comfortable experimenting but you also understand what it takes to move from an experiment to something reliable and maintainable.
   

  

 You collaborate well with others and can connect technology with business needs. You are curious about the rapidly evolving AI landscape while maintaining a thoughtful approach to areas such as security, privacy, explainability, quality, and responsible AI.
   

  

 At CGI, you will have the opportunity to work with AI and machine learning across different industries, technologies, and business challenges. You'll be part of a collaborative environment where you can learn from experienced colleagues, contribute your own ideas, and continue developing your expertise.
   

  

 We combine the reach and opportunities of a global organization with strong local teams and close collaboration with our clients. If you're excited about building useful AI solutions, and want to help organizations move from AI possibilities to practical outcomes, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
SOVOS
   

  

 Senior Solutions Engineer
   

  

 Sales Engineering·Full-Time·Europe
   

  

 Build Your Future With Us
   

  

 The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
   

  

 We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
   

  

 AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 At Sovos, we're building a dedicated sales team from the ground up to support our growing portfolio of AI-native offerings, spanning financial orchestration, compliance automation, and intelligent invoicing. You'll be one of the first technical sellers on this team, joining at the foundation as we define the playbook together. This isn't a support role that ends with a good demo. You'll own technical opportunities end-to-end, configuring the platform to a client's real environment and building the technical proof points your Account Executive partner uses to close.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Carry a quota tied to technical opportunity progression from discovery through close, owning the technical inputs (POC results, integration effort, system fit) that feed the ROI and TCO business case.
* Lead technical workshops and proofs of concept with clear success criteria, partnering with your AE to navigate objections, build urgency, and drive the opportunity to a decision.
* Configure the platform against a client's real data and workflows ahead of every demo, navigating model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT.
* Translate technical solutions into ROI, TCO, and operational impact for Finance and executive stakeholders, moving seamlessly between architecture conversations and business-level discussions.
* Leverage AI tools to improve qualification, demo configuration, and business case development, staying engaged through kickoff and early delivery to maintain technical continuity with the Field Delivery Engineering team.
* Help shape the qualification criteria, demo approach, and business case format this team will use going forwards, bringing customer and market feedback back into how Sovos positions and packages its AI-native offerings.


 What You Bring to Sovos
   

  

* You've successfully led business process transformation or procurement optimization projects, ideally gained through consulting or working buyer-side, ideally with procurement or AP expertise gained from working buyer-side rather than solely in an advisory capacity.
* You have enough systems fluency to know where a client's data lives (SAP vs. Ariba vs. elsewhere) and how workflows cross systems; familiarity with AI gateways, model routing, or data governance is a strong plus.
* You bring direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle, not only demo or support experience, with a demonstrated ability to close complex B2B deals with clear revenue accountability, moving opportunities from technical discovery through contract signature and clear revenue accountability.
* You're comfortable moving between technical and executive conversations in the same day (sometimes the same meeting), building executive-level business cases that include ROI and TCO analyses.
* Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and automation or workflow platforms is important; experience selling AI infrastructure, applications, agents, workflow automation, or finance technology is preferred.
* Experience helping launch a new product or build an early go-to-market motion is preferred, as is experience at a consulting firm with a finance transformation or automation practice.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.


 The Process
   

  

 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
   

  

 1
   

  

 Pre-Employment Assessment
   

  

 Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
   

  

 2
   

  

 Video Interview
   

  

 A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
   

  

 3
   

  

 Meeting with a Recruiter
   

  

 A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
   

  

 4
   

  

 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
   

  

 Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
   

  

 Life at Sovos
   

  

 The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* An opportunity to work with a global team
* Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs
* Globally recognised Training and Development programmes
* Competitive benefits package


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

 Company Background
   

  

 Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.
   

  

 Ready to make your move?

**Client-facing advisory and delivery leadership**

title: Product Manager

**About Plus1** 




  





 Plus1 is a fast-growing fintech on a mission to give people total control over their personal finances. We don’t just offer loans, we build digital solutions and provide expert advisory services that make a real difference across Europe. Plus1 is part of 0TO9 AB, a licensed credit market company supervised by the Swedish FSA (Finansinspektionen).

 Learn more about
 
 Plus1

 We are looking for a Product Manager who doesn’t just set direction, but builds. You will join our product and tech team of 11 in Stockholm, report directly to the CEO and work closely with the management team.
 



  





 We don’t split the product into silos with individual owners. We work full stack, all hands on deck, across the entire customer and business chain. Priorities are set together with management, with special focus on:
 



  




* Traffic generation
* Onboarding and conversion
* Retention and dunning
* The credit granting process
* Market expansion
* Internal systems used by our advisors and customer service agents

* Contributing to launches in new markets, from requirements and partner setup to go-live.

* 3-5 years of experience in consumer credit, financial services or another regulated business, ideally as a product manager, product owner or in business development.

* Report directly to the CEO, with short decision paths and real influence.

* Be part of our expansion into new European markets.
* Work in a high-ceiling, innovative environment in the heart of Stockholm, where you and your ideas actually matter.

title: Driftingenjör inom telekom

Svenska kraftnät står i startgroparna för att installera nya generationens våglängdsteknik över hela landet.  I arbetet ingår att konfigurera, felsöka och incidenthantera Svenska kraftnäts DWDM- och SDH-plattformar samt ge stöd till entreprenörer vid felsökning i Svenska kraftnäts utrustningar och fibernät.
   

  

 Rollen innefattar även att du:
   

  

* Deltar som teknikresurs i transmissionsnäts- och IT-projekt där behov av telekommunikation finns
* Efter genomförd introduktion och upplärning ingår schemalagd beredskapstjänstgöring 2nd Line inom området telekommunikation cirka var 5-6:e vecka.


 Du kommer att tillhöra enheten för telekommunikation som består av ett tiotal medarbetare som i sina olika roller arbetar med att förvalta och utveckla kommunikationsnätet och tillhörande system.
   

  

 Om dig
   

  

 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en nyfiken, engagerad och lösningsorienterad person som motiveras av att arbeta i en miljö präglad av utveckling och förändring. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete och har förmågan att prioritera och fatta välavvägda beslut i en vardag där tempot periodvis är högt.
   

  

 Du är samarbetsinriktad och bidrar till ett öppet och prestigelöst arbetsklimat där fokus ligger på att nå gemensamma mål. title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
   

  

 Why Lovable?
   

  

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

* Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
* A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
* Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
* Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
* Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
* Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
* A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.


 What you’ll do
   

  

* Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
* Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
* Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
* Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
* Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
* Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
* Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.


 Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: AI Research Engineer, Post-Training
description:
**TL;DR:**
 Lovable lets over 2 million people build software using plain language, and the models behind it need to be exceptional. We're hiring an engineer who has gotten their hands dirty with post-training at scale and wants to do it again for one of the fastest-growing AI products in the world.
   

  

 You'll own our full post-training pipeline: translating the latest research into production training recipes, adapting them for code generation and agent workloads, and putting improved models in front of users fast. The goal is to get promising research into production within days or weeks, not months. This isn't an academic research position - you'll spend as much time in production infrastructure as in training configs, and your success is measured by what ships.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving.  We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* You've personally run post-training jobs on large language models - RFT/RLVR, preference optimization, or similar. Not just called APIs or written prompts, but actually trained and iterated on models
* You can write solid production code. The systems you build need to run reliably, not just produce interesting research artifacts
* You're fluent in at least one major ML framework (PyTorch, JAX) and comfortable working with distributed training setups and GPU clusters
* You understand the math behind preference optimization, reward modeling, and alignment techniques - and can reason about when each approach fits
* You've built or significantly contributed to evaluation systems that capture real-world quality, not just benchmark scores
* You can trace a model quality regression from user-facing symptoms back through serving, inference, and training - and you enjoy doing it
* You want to ship. Research taste matters, but at Lovable the question is always "how fast can we get this to users?"


**Preferred:**
* You've worked on code generation or agentic use cases specifically
* You've put post-trained models into the hands of real users and seen how they hold up at scale
* You've owned the full loop: curating data, running training, evaluating results, deploying, and monitoring in production
* You have a habit of reading a paper on Monday and having a prototype running by Friday
* You've experimented with speculative decoding or similar techniques to improve model efficiency
* You have strong views on evaluation methodology and have built evals that actually predict user satisfaction
* You've published or contributed meaningfully to the open-source ML ecosystem


**What You’ll Do**
* Own the full lifecycle of Lovable's post-training pipeline - from data curation and training runs through evaluation and deployment
* Apply and adapt reinforcement learning, preference optimization, and supervised fine-tuning methods to make our models better at generating code, reasoning about user intent, and acting as reliable agents
* Build the evaluation and experimentation infrastructure that tells us whether a model change actually helps users - covering helpfulness, safety, latency, and reliability
* Develop and operate the production systems that run training jobs at scale, including GPU orchestration and data pipelines
* Work across team boundaries with our agent, product, and infrastructure engineers to turn model gains into product improvements users can feel
* Investigate and resolve failures end-to-end - whether the root cause is in a training recipe, a data issue, or a serving regression
* Read papers, run experiments, and move fast: the goal is to get promising research into production within days or weeks, not months


**About Your Application**

title: Tech Procurement Specialist
description:
**TL;DR:**
 You'll own how Lovable sources and negotiates the vendor relationships that power the product: deals taken end-to-end from "an engineer needs this" to a signed contract, the economics modelled properly, and the process and data left better each time. Procurement judgement first, tooling second — we'll help you with the second part.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**The portfolio you'd own**
 This is a big book from day one. Lovable runs on a fast-growing stack of software, infrastructure and services, and the pace of that hasn't slowed since launch.
   

  

* 10–25 live processes at any given time, and a multi-million dollar value portfolio. Real money, genuinely custom commercial and legal terms, and no dedicated owner today. You’ll get to set the playbook, not inherit someone else's.
* Decisions that land in the P&L. These are numbers big enough to matter at company level, which means the gap between an average outcome and a sharp one is visible from the top. Few procurement roles offer this much line of sight from a single negotiation to the financials.
* A seat at the biggest tables. You'll work alongside Finance, Legal, EPD and Partnerships on the relationships that matter most to how the company operates, and the mandate grows as the company does — we're scaling fast, and so is what this role owns.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Required experience: 5+ years of tech procurement and vendor management. You know the platforms and benchmarking sources that tell you what "good" looks like for a company our size.
* Commercially sharp negotiator: you compare offers, find leverage, and know when to push, when to walk away and when to escalate. You don't only chase a lower number: you reframe the shape of a contract so it works better for both sides. Precise, prepared, calm under pressure.
* Technically fluent and financially rigorous: you grasp technical concepts well enough to partner with Product and Engineering, translate requirements into commercial implications, and pressure-test vendor claims. You can also model pricing structures, commitments, credits, discounts, ramps, usage scenarios, renewal options, minimums and overages, and land on a clear recommendation.
* Process-minded: you ask where the data should live, what should be standard next time, and what should never again depend on someone remembering. One-off heroics become playbooks.
* Fluent enough in product and engineering context: you can sit with a PM or an engineer, understand what a vendor actually powers, and carry that into the commercial conversation.
* Data-comfortable and AI-native: messy data from contracts, invoices, billing exports, usage and vendor portals doesn't faze you, and you use AI as leverage by default. Some SQL, scripting or no-code helps. We'll support you here — curiosity matters more than existing skill.


**What You’ll Do**
* Run sourcing and vendor negotiations end-to-end: need, market scan, RFP/RFQ, commercial modelling and legal negotiation, recommendation, approval, signature and renewal readiness. The whole process, not one slice of it.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, Product and Engineering: FP&A and business owners on demand, Product and Engineering on requirements, Legal on risk and redlines, vendor fit and implementation risk.
* Support strategic partnerships and complex deals: non-standard relationships where Lovable may be customer, vendor, partner or infrastructure buyer at once. Partnerships owns the front end; you pick it up at deal economics and carry it to signature.
* Turn deal structures into decisions: scenarios, walk-away positions and a crisp memo people can act on.
* Enrich the flow and the systems behind it: intake today is close to binary — here's what I want to buy, here are the reviews. Bring in vendor intelligence and deal benchmarking, build up the contract, renewal and SLA data, and evolve intake, approvals and CLM so every agreement lands in the right system with the right metadata.
* Automate the parts that shouldn't need judgement: vendor research, contract extraction, renewal alerts, benchmark gathering, approval routing and negotiation prep.


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**Stockholm | Full-time | Onsite, five days a week**
 The team
   

  

 AI Enablement makes Legora AI-native by default. We work across three streams in parallel: building internal agents and tools, equipping teams to build their own, and owning the standards, access and guardrails that let everyone move fast safely.
   

  

 We own the AI platforms and the internal products built on them. So far that includes Leya, an internal knowledge agent live in Slack that answers questions about Legora with cited sources and automates parts of our RFP and security questionnaire work. A structured, agent-readable knowledge base assembled from knowledge each domain continues to own, where agents propose changes and humans approve them. Leyf, a platform for internally built apps that lands anyone's app on shared infrastructure with guardrails scaled to how much damage it could do. And a Skills Hub, so that something one person works out becomes something the whole company can use rather than staying on their laptop.
   

  

 The team is small and the mandate is large. That is the job.
   

  

 What makes this hard
   

  

 Legora is an AI company of around a thousand people, most already fluent and on current tools. Internal AI here is not an adoption problem. Nobody needs convincing, which means there is nowhere to hide behind change management or training. If something we build is not used, it is because it was not good enough.
   

  

 Our colleagues know what good looks like and will not use something worse than what they think they could build themselves in an afternoon. So we ship things people genuinely want, and the foundations arrive with them. That constraint does not go away.
   

  

 The mandate is also larger than the team. The part no individual can do for themselves is the infrastructure, the access model and the architecture underneath, and getting that right across a company this size is the actual work. It does not come with a specification.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 You will take broad ownership of how AI works inside Legora and of the platforms we build to make it work.
   

  

* Build internal agents, tools and platforms, and treat them as products rather than projects. Quality, reliability and whether they actually serve the business are yours, not someone else's
* Take a broad goal, work out what is actually required, and break it into the work yourself
* Own what you build end to end, from the architecture through to whether people use it and it holds up in production
* Shape what we should build and in what order, and argue for it
* Design the foundations: knowledge architecture, access and permissions, evaluation and monitoring, the guardrails that scale with risk
* Work directly with the people who will use what you build, across the whole company, including the parts furthest from engineering


 Who we are looking for
   

  

* Strong engineering fundamentals. You build production systems, not prototypes that need someone else to finish them
* Real depth with LLM-based systems. Agents, retrieval, evaluation, tool use. You know where these systems break and you design for it
* Ownership by instinct. You do not wait for a specification. When the requirement is unclear or wrong, you say so and propose something better
* Three kinds of understanding at once. Technical, domain and business. You can hold a conversation about architecture and a conversation about what the business actually needs, and connect them
* Openness. You take feedback, build on other people's ideas, change your mind when the evidence moves, and push for the strongest outcome rather than the one you proposed first
* Comfort with ambiguity. New team, fast growth, decisions that get revisited as we learn. That should sound appealing rather than annoying
* TypeScript. It's what we work in, and where our shared patterns live
* No aversion to infrastructure. We own ours, so Terraform and cloud providers are part of the work rather than someone else's problem
* You work with code agents daily. Not as an experiment, as how you build


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
